saw_lines: Patients don’t pick a dentist on price. They pick the one they already trust before the first visit.
So proof has to do the selling in the ad, before anyone reads the disclaimer.
7,000+ five star reviews, and 1 of your 40 live ads mentions them. Put the reviews in the first line of every ad.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active AU ads, 9 Oct 2026
points: 31 of 40 ads carry the full risk disclaimer, around 40% of the words in a typical ad. Keep it, but after a two line hook, with the rest behind the link.
7,000+ five star Google reviews and Red Diamond Invisalign status sit on the site. 1 ad of 40 mentions reviews, 1 mentions Red Diamond.
A free 60 minute Smile Discovery Session and 60 months interest free are on the site. Only 9 ads mention anything free, 1 mentions interest free.
4 ads use the identical “It’s a common question we get asked” text for whitening, implant cost, dentures and veneers. Each question deserves its own hook.

ads_1: Hooks per treatment, veneers, aligners and implants, written within AHPRA rules
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
